selection_policy: All target relations are evaluated from native pixels with their named scene owners. Public bundle exposure is recorded separately from formal selection and from source/index availability. A selected bundle does not automatically activate its associated visual profiles.

targets.source_definition: the matte surface has broad subdued shading; the adjacent metal surface carries a limited sharper highlight; the adjacent glass retains its distinct reflection and transmission
targets.owner: The matte charcoal console surround, adjacent brushed-steel rim, and cabin window under the same dusk and console illumination
required_visible_components: Matte charcoal console surround has broad subdued shading
Adjacent brushed-steel rim carries a narrower and sharper localized glint
Adjacent window glass has its own faint interior reflection and transmits the exterior dish
targets.confusion_boundary: A uniform plastic gloss across all three materials fails.
targets.scene_adaptation: Console material trio is the scene-specific manifestation of the public surface-focus bundle.

targets.source_definition: the selected subject plane remains crisp; the middle-distance environmental forms remain recognizable; the farther background loses fine detail consistently with its depth
targets.owner: The adult face, both operating hands and selector in the selected plane; meter faces in middle distance; dish outside the window at far distance
required_visible_components: Adult eyes, both hands and selector remain crisp
Intermediate console meter faces remain recognizable
Far dish loses fine detail with depth while retaining its dish shape
targets.confusion_boundary: All-over sharpness or fully abstract background blur fails.
targets.scene_adaptation: The meter faces and dish make a cabin-specific depth ladder.

targets.source_definition: the window-side sleeve receives cool window light; the lamp-side tabletop receives warmer local light; the source-bound color zones mix gradually where their illumination overlaps
targets.owner: Window-side overshirt sleeve, paper and fingertips on warm console side, and forearm across their overlap
required_visible_components: Cool window-side illumination is visible on the window-side sleeve
Warmer console illumination is visible on the paper and fingertips
The color zones meet gradually on the forearm rather than appearing as unrelated color grading
targets.confusion_boundary: A global blue-orange tint without source-bound receiving surfaces fails.
targets.scene_adaptation: Console indicator lamps stand in for the generic warm lamp-side tabletop; bundle was exposed but not formally selected.

targets.source_definition: a visible window frame locates the glass plane; the glass reflection corresponds to the opposite facade; the interior beyond the pane remains readable through another part of the glass
targets.owner: The framed cabin window, faint amber reflection of actual interior status lamps, and exterior radio dish transmitted through the pane
required_visible_components: Visible window frame locates the glass plane
Interior lamp reflection is attached to that glass plane and corresponds to the visible amber status lamps
The exterior dish remains readable through another region of the same glass
targets.confusion_boundary: A mirror-only pane, floating reflected lamps, or an opaque dish pasted in front of the window fails.
targets.scene_adaptation: The public bundle names an opposite facade and interior beyond; this inward-looking cabin uses reflected interior lamps and transmitted exterior dish, so the bundle was not adopted verbatim.

targets.source_definition: wear is localized to the gripping area of the selected handle; the adjacent unhandled surface remains comparatively intact; the handle keeps a continuous solid shape through the worn area
targets.owner: Red selector ridges gripped by the adult right fingers and adjacent unhandled coated metal
required_visible_components: Small polished wear is localized to the selector ridges at the right-hand gripping area
Neighboring unhandled coating is comparatively intact
The red selector retains one continuous solid shape through the worn area
targets.confusion_boundary: Uniform scratches across the whole console, random image grain, or broken selector geometry fails.
targets.scene_adaptation: Selector grip is the scene-specific handle; this relation exists in source/index only and was not added to the public pack.
